blocks.text:
Rust resistant coating ensures long term outdoor use. These sturdy floral cages withstand seasons, offering reliable plant cages for outdoor plants. Keeps peonies, climbers, and heavy veggies neatly supported.
Excellent as peony cages, cucumber cages, or general garden hoops. Promotes plant vitality by preventing drooping and improving air circulation. A practical, durable choice for diverse planting needs.

Specifications:
Material: iron
Color: green
Size: about 15.7 x 23.6 inches/ 40 x 60 cm

Notes:
Manual measurement, please allow slight errors on size.
The color may exist a slight difference due to different screen displays

items.label: Peony Cages and Supports
items.value: this set includes 4 peony cages, each with a 15.7 inch diameter plant support ring and 23.6 inch height; Made of thick iron wire with a rust resistant green coating, ideal as plant cages for outdoor plants like peonies, roses, and hydrangeas

items.label: 4 Legged Heavy Duty Plant Support Design
items.value: made of thickened wire, these metal plant support cages are resistant to bending and deformation; Equipped with 4 reinforced legs, they ensure stability, keeping plants upright even in wind and rain; A sturdy peony plant cage support solution

items.label: Multi Functional Garden Plant Support Cages for Entire Growth Cycle
items.value: with its long legs, high dimensions, and ample depth, this heavy duty plant support cage provides sufficient climbing length for vines, especially suitable for rapid vine growth in the early to mid stages, without feeling cramped

items.label: Quick Assembly Flower Support Rings
items.value: Easy to install and disassemble; simply attach the legs to the metal support rings. Convenient for seasonal storage, these garden plant stakes are friendly to both novice and experienced gardeners

items.label: Beautiful Green Finish plant cages
items.value: The green tomato cages blend naturally with garden plants, providing unobtrusive yet sturdy support; Helping plants grow healthily upwards while maintaining the beauty of the garden
